title: Receiver-Owned Advancement for Karpathy Autoresearch
question: Can Karpathy autoresearch keep its train.py research surface while the keep/discard decision is moved to an independent receiver-owned gate?

requirements: exact upstream commit and immutable upstream blobs are bound
candidate stdout cannot become receiver score
signed acceptance is bound to exact base and candidate
receipt replay after accepted-base movement fails binding

live_gpu_protocol.required_hardware: single NVIDIA GPU compatible with pinned upstream
live_gpu_protocol.measurement: receiver executes candidate in a clean worktree and intercepts the protected prepare.evaluate_bpb result; agent-authored stdout is not the score source
live_gpu_protocol.baseline_cache: the accepted commit's measured result is cached receiver-side so each new candidate requires one training run, matching the upstream one-run-per-experiment economics
live_gpu_protocol.promotion: signed receipt plus exact base/candidate binding plus receiver-measured improvement

claim_boundary: The control-plane result is not a GPU training result.
It does not show autoresearch productivity improves under OpenLine.
It does not claim hostile-process or OS-level isolation.
It does not claim a malicious train.py cannot game the scientific benchmark itself.
A live GPU result requires a separately preserved receiver receipt.
